title: Golden Yellow Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf - 8.75-Inch Wall-Mount Covered Two-Post Solid Brass, Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep toilet tissue protected and your bathroom essentials off the counter with a covered holder and an integrated glass shelf—built from solid brass and backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality.

  • Golden Yellow transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Clean, finished look: Concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Built to last: Crafted from solid brass materials.
  • Coordinated style: Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Waverly Place collection—ideal for transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Specs

  • Product dimensions: 8.75 in L x 4.6 in H x 6 in W
  • Projection: 6 in
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount, concealed screw mounting (screw size: #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Weight capacity: 250 lb
  • Included: Toilet paper holder and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
